#NOTE Asda listing, read 2026-10-08 from the shop's own category/shelf pages at https://www.asda.com/groceries/<department>/<aisle>/<shelf> (groceries.asda.com now redirects to www.asda.com). Line format: product_id|name|price|unit_price|unit|price2|unit_price2|card|photo
#NOTE The Asda tiles are lazy-rendered (they stay empty skeletons in a background Chrome tab), so the extractor reads the data the page itself holds in memory for each tile (React props of the product-module: productId, brand, productName, price, weightPerUnitFormatted, availabilityStatus, productImage) instead of the visible text. name = brand + one space + productName (this is how the visible tiles read: brand "ASDA" + "British Milk Semi Skimmed 4 Pints" shows as "ASDA British Milk Semi Skimmed 4 Pints"; checked on 6 visible tiles); product_id = the id at the end of the product URL (/groceries/product/<slug>/<id>).
#NOTE price = the current shelf price in pounds (a "Rollback" tile's price is the reduced price; the old crossed-out price is ignored). Out-of-stock tiles ("Out of stock" button) have EMPTY price fields. unit_price/unit: "72.6p/lt" -> 0.726 per litre, "5.52/kg" -> 5.52 per kg. Asda has no loyalty-card shelf price (the card columns are always empty; multi-buys such as "Any 2 for 4" are ignored).
#NOTE photo = the value after https://asdagroceries.scene7.com/is/image/asdagroceries/ (the tile shows <value>_ plus Scene7 size options); it is the barcode (EAN) for branded items and an Asda number for own-brand items (e.g. 165468 -> 20337087).
#NOTE Each shelf page can show up to 63 tiles; bigger shelves say "Showing 1-63 items of 124 ... Page 1 2 of 2" and are loaded as ?page=2 etc. Only the main product grid is read (not the "Popular right now"/"Offers we found" carousels). To save copying, each line is printed ONCE: a product already printed under an earlier shelf is not printed again (header says "tiles T | new M": T = tiles on the page, M = lines that follow). Shelf pages (depth 4) contain all products of their sub-shelves (tested: whole-milk, semi-skimmed-milk, goats-milk are subsets of fresh-milk), so sub-shelves are not walked.
